modules.title: 同一进程里的两个线程怎样共享缓存
共享内存为什么需要同步

items.title: 问题与关键机制
items.text: 同一进程里的两个线程同时读写共享缓存时，后写入者可能覆盖前一个结果；确认共享对象和线程关系后，用锁、队列或不可变结果约束写入顺序，并记录可观察状态。

items.title: 改善看共享结果是否稳定
items.text: 重复并发运行后最终值始终正确，说明这段共享访问得到控制；线程仍不是独立进程，崩溃和内存影响可能留在同一进程内。

items.title: 视频导出也会使用共享线程
items.text: 视频导出器用多个线程处理片段时，它们共享同一进度计数；更新必须同步，避免进度倒退或漏计。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 线程属于进程内部并通常共享内存；它不是轻量版的独立进程。线程是否并行、适合 CPU 还是 I/O 工作取决于语言运行时和调度环境，不能只凭线程数量下结论。

lessonPractice.title: 线程 A 和线程 B 属于同一进程，并同时更新共享缓存。最需要先确认什么？

options.label: 确认共享状态的读写是否有锁、队列或其他同步规则
options.feedback: 对。同一进程的线程共享内存，并发修改需要明确访问顺序和可观察结果。

options.label: 确认两个线程一定拥有不同的进程 ID 和完全隔离内存
options.feedback: 同一进程中的线程通常共享同一个 PID 对应的内存空间。

options.label: 继续增加线程数量，用更多并发自动消除覆盖问题
options.feedback: 更多竞争者会增加共享状态冲突，不会自动建立同步。

en.title: Thread A and B belong to one process and update a shared cache concurrently. What should you verify first?

options.label: Verify that shared reads and writes use a lock, queue, or another synchronization rule
options.feedback: Correct. Threads in one process share memory, so concurrent mutation needs an explicit order and evidence.

options.label: Verify that each thread has a different process ID and fully isolated memory
options.feedback: Threads in one process normally share its memory and process identity.

options.label: Add more threads so extra concurrency automatically removes overwrites
options.feedback: More competitors do not create synchronization and can increase conflicts.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这段并发代码里有哪些线程属于同一个进程、共享了哪些状态。为共享缓存写入补上合适的同步边界，并记录进程 ID、线程 ID 和最终值。让两个线程同时运行多次，确认不会丢失更新。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Identify which threads belong to the same process and which state they share. Add an appropriate synchronization boundary around shared-cache writes and record process ID, thread ID, and final value. Run two threads concurrently several times and verify no update is lost.

learning.assumes: You know one process can keep handling multiple requests.
learning.outcome: You can identify threads in one process, determine whether they share memory, and ask for synchronization evidence during concurrent updates.

modules.title: How two threads in one process share a cache

items.title: Problem and key mechanism
items.text: When two threads in one process read and write a shared cache at the same time, a later write can overwrite an earlier result; after confirming the shared object and thread relationship, use a lock, queue, or immutable result to order writes and record observable state.

items.title: Verify stable shared results
items.text: Repeated concurrent runs should keep the correct final value. Threads still share the process failure and memory boundary.

items.title: Video export also uses shared threads
items.text: When a video exporter processes segments on multiple threads, they share one progress counter. Updates must be synchronized to prevent regressions or missed progress.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A thread belongs inside a process and usually shares its memory; it is not an isolated process. Parallel behavior and suitability for CPU or I/O work depend on the runtime and scheduler.

distinctions.label: Process
distinctions.text: A {c:thread} exists inside a process and shares its address space; a {c:process} is an isolated execution environment with separate memory and PID.

distinctions.label: Coroutine
distinctions.text: A {c:thread} is preemptively scheduled by the OS kernel; a {c:coroutine} is cooperatively scheduled in user space.
